Alok Kondebettu
alokrk04@gmail.com | +91 8660338051 | Bengaluru, India
Associate QA Tester
SUMMARY
Data Science & Analytics Intern with around 0+ years of experience in data analysis and business intelligence. Delivered a CNN‑based skin cancer detection 
model that reached 92% accuracy and engineered fraud detection models handling over 50/K transactions. Designed and launched KPI dashboards that 
streamlined reporting for telecom, finance, and retail projects, improving insight delivery for cross‑functional teams. Known for clear communication, 
adaptability, and effective collaboration across stakeholders.
SKILLS
Quality Assurance & Game Testing: Game Testing, Bug Reporting, Bug Tracking Systems, Game Console Testing, PC Testing, In-House Software 
Systems
Programming & Scripting: Python, SQL, C, Git
Development Tools: Microsoft Office Suite, VS Code, PyCharm, Jupyter Notebook, Flask
Data Analysis & ETL: Data Cleaning, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Data Modeling, ETL
Data Visualization: Tableau, Matplotlib, Plotly, Seaborn
Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, XGBoost
WORK EXPERIENCE
Amdox Technologies
Remote
Data Science & Analytics Intern
Nov 2025 - Present
• Conducted functional testing of data extraction scripts using SQL and Python on Windows PCs, identified 12+ data anomalies, logged each issue in the 
internal bug tracking system, and collaborated with engineering to resolve, ensuring data integrity for churn analysis.
• Executed comprehensive data cleaning validation across heterogeneous sources, documenting inconsistencies in detailed English reports, adapting 
processes to new data schemas, and updating in‑house data processing tools to enhance model readiness.
• Designed interactive KPI dashboards in Excel and Tableau, delivering weekly status reports in clear written English to cross‑functional teams, facilitating 
rapid decision‑making and demonstrating strong communication and team collaboration.
• Automated reporting pipelines using Python scripts, integrating automated data quality checks that flagged 15+ issues per release, recorded each in the 
bug tracking platform, and coordinated with stakeholders to prioritize fixes, showcasing adaptability and interpersonal skills.
• Validated data processing scripts on both Windows PCs and Linux‑based build servers, mirroring console and PC testing environments, and captured 
any execution failures in the internal ticketing system for prompt resolution.
PROJECTS
Skin Cancer Detection using Machine Learning
• Developed a CNN-based detection model achieving 92% diagnostic accuracy.
• Processed and analyzed 10K+ dermoscopy images.
• Stack: TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Flask.
Cryptocurrency Price Forecasting
• Implemented ARIMA, SARIMA, and LSTM models for Bitcoin forecasting.
• Conducted trend and volatility analysis using historical price data.
• Tools: Python, matplotlib, plotly, seaborn.
Real-Time Financial Fraud Detection
• Built fraud detection models using XGBoost and Random Forest.
• Analyzed 50K+ transactions to detect anomalies.
• Created dashboards for fraud velocity and risk analysis.
• Tools: Python, TensorFlow, Streamlit.
EDUCATION
VSM's Somashekhar R Kothiwale Institute of Technology, Nipani, Karnataka
Nipani
Computer Science and Engineering
Dec 2022 - Jul 2026
• 8.6 CGPA
CERTIFICATIONS
• Deloitte – Data Analytics Job Simulation
• Oracle – OCI 2025 Certified Data Science Professional
• Tata – GenAI Powered Data Analytics
